His SoundCloud tracks gained viral traction in 2015-2016, leading to a major label deal in early 2017 at age 19.

His SoundCloud singles like 'Catch Me Outside' gained viral traction, leading to a deal with Victor Victor/Republic Records in 2017.
family_context_summary: Born in Fort Lauderdale, FL, of Jamaican descent. His father was a rapper who used the stage name 'Sin City' and actively pushed his son to write rap music. Parents played Jamaican music around the house.

The Broward County SoundCloud rap scene and the Members Only collective provided a high-trust peer ecosystem. His father's direct involvement in rap music gave him early domain fluency, while the SoundCloud platform served as his primary distribution channel. The structural wave of SoundCloud rap in 2015-2017 was the dominant macro lever.

name: XXXTentacion
milestone_by_age_26: Released debut album 17 (2017) peaking at #2 on Billboard 200 and second album ? (2018) debuting at #1, both certified triple platinum; single 'Sad!' posthumously reached #1 on Billboard Hot 100 with diamond certification. Died at age 20 in June 2018.
early_history_summary: Jahseh Onfroy was born in Plantation, FL to Jamaican parents and raised primarily by his grandmother due to his mother's personal problems. He had a deeply traumatic childhood including witnessing his uncle's suicide, alleged sexual abuse, and his father's imprisonment on RICO charges. He began making music on SoundCloud in 2013 after being released from juvenile detention, where he met Ski Mask the Slump God. His single 'Look at Me!' went viral on SoundCloud in late 2015/2016, launching him to mainstream attention.
family_context_summary: Born to Jamaican parents in Plantation, FL; father was jailed on RICO charges when Onfroy was 10 and later deported to Jamaica. Raised primarily by his grandmother in Lauderhill due to his mother's personal problems. Both father and grandfather were Rastafarians.
parent_family_domain_summary: No evidence of parental music industry connection. Father was absent due to imprisonment. Grandmother served as primary caregiver but no documented domain expertise in music.

evidence_summary: XXXTentacion's early trajectory was defined by extreme adversity—traumatic childhood, absent father, juvenile detention—which catalyzed his music as an emotional outlet. His partnership with Ski Mask the Slump God and the Members Only collective provided a peer ecosystem, while SoundCloud served as the primary distribution platform. His musical versatility across emo, trap, and punk genres was unusual and contributed to his rapid viral ascent. The SoundCloud rap structural wave of 2015-2017 was the dominant macro lever. No evidence of family financial platform or parental domain expertise.

name: Juice WRLD

His religious mother prohibited hip-hop but allowed rock and pop, exposing him to artists via video games. He learned piano at age four and later guitar, drums, and trumpet. He began posting songs to SoundCloud in his sophomore year of high school under the name JuicetheKidd, recording on his smartphone, and signed with Lil Bibby's Grade A Productions in 2017.

His mother's prohibition of hip-hop paradoxically shaped his genre-blending style by exposing him to rock and pop.
